svg.title: Memory coalescing: the 32 loads of a warp are combined into accesses of 32-byte sectors; consecutive addresses need 4 sectors, a stride of 2 needs 8 sectors of which half is wasted, a stride of 8 or more needs 32 sectors of which only 4 bytes each are used
svg.text: green: 32-byte sectors transferred · blue: the 4 bytes a thread needs
same rule on the CPU: memory moves in cache lines of 64 (or 128) bytes
